  - 5f1895a7 (Fix oss-fuzz issue 64237 - NtpLayer.cpp)

- Identify the specific fix commit for issue 42530090 (likely one of the commits in the chain or a nearby commit)
- Analyze the vulnerable code path to understand the exact trigger condition
- Construct the malicious .pcap file that causes the heap-buffer-overflow WRITE 2

- Submit the PoC and trace file
